content_blocks.label: lead_paragraph
content_blocks.text: Hundreds of liberal activists have taken to the streets to protest a new tax bill that they claim disproportionately benefits the wealthy and undermines social welfare programs.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_1
content_blocks.text: The bill, known as the Economic Growth and Fiscal Responsibility Act (EGFRA), includes significant tax cuts for corporations and high-income individuals, while cutting funding for public services such as education and healthcare.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_2
content_blocks.text: Protesters argue that the bill will exacerbate income inequality and leave millions of Americans without access to essential services.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_3
content_blocks.text: ‘This is a clear example of how the wealthy and powerful continue to enrich themselves at the expense of the working class,’ said activist Jane Smith. ‘We need a tax system that works for everyone, not just the elite.’

content_blocks.label: pull_quote
content_blocks.text: ‘The EGFRA is a slap in the face to the middle class and the poor. It’s time to stand up and demand a fairer tax system.’ – Jane Smith
